entities.summary: Elvin Mamishzada is an Azerbaijani boxer. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, he competed in the men's flyweightevent, but was defeated in the first round by Nyambayaryn Tögstsogt of Mongolia. In the 2016 Summer Olympics, he lost in the quarter-final round against the eventual gold medalist, Shakhobidin Zoirov from Uzbekistan.
